summary: Add fetch_failures (and FetchFailures) to envelopeMetadataArrayKeys so the novel commands' partial-failure sidecar never counts as a competing payload array in compact mode.
reason: Extends scrape-creators-compact-payload-array: resolveVerboseObjectFields keeps a blocked key (comments) only when no other non-empty array-of-objects competes for 'the payload'. The novel fan-out commands (comments thread/sweep) emit a fetch_failures array-of-objects bookkeeping sidecar next to comments; it was not listed in envelopeMetadataArrayKeys (only errors/warnings), so a single failed reply fetch made --agent/--compact strip the entire paid comments payload - the exact paid-call-no-data loss the base patch exists to prevent. Durable rule for reprints: any partial-failure bookkeeping array the CLI itself synthesizes is envelope metadata, never a domain collection.
validated_outcome: TestCompactKeepsCommentsDespiteFetchFailures pins the case: a thread envelope with a non-empty fetch_failures sidecar keeps both comments under compactFields. Found by ce-code-review run 20260808-165614-46b8c9c8 (agent-native lens), validated by independent inspection.
